scenes.narration: The biggest island on Earth has fewer people than a small city. So why do the world's great powers keep circling it?
Greenland sits between North America and Europe, right on the shortest route between them.
It belongs to the Kingdom of Denmark, thousands of kilometres away.
About fifty six thousand people. Two million square kilometres.
And as the ice retreats, new sea routes and minerals come within reach.
